newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Greenfields to raise US$235 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Greenfields to raise US$235 million.

text.p: Greenfields Coal Co Ltd said on Monday it had appointed Credit Suisse First Boston as its exclusive financial adviser on the proposed US$235 million financing of the Coal Recovery LLC project in West Virginia, United States.
The company said the financing would consist of equity and debt directly into the project, which involved the reclamation of coal and conversion to synthetic fuel products.

Funds would be used to build coal recovery and pyrolysis plants before June 30 next year as part of a plan to produce up to 4.5 million tons of fine unpyrolised coal and other coal products, the company said.
"Production of fine unpyrolised coal from the first reclamation project at Gary, West Virginia, is timetabled to commence in April 1997," Greenfields said.
"The company is currently concluding a contract for the sale of the coal produced from that facility," the company said.
